214. Brothers (1)
'Father and the expedition endured such a long time, enduring a situation where everyone could only die or become a monster, and they are still enduring it now...'
Luna had left for the Black Sea with Chiron in early 1799. Now, as December 1803 began, it was almost 5 years.
However, Luna didn't have much to tell.
All she did in the Black Sea was killing monsters, eating, walking through the chaotic dark land, and battling the king of the Black Sea.

"...That was everything. I worried about Father every day and continued through the Black Sea. In fact, I and the other members were almost certain that Father would eventually succumb to the demonic nature and become a monster. That day would probably be the day the expedition ended. What I was afraid of was not death, but everyone becoming a monster."
If we had become monsters, it would probably have been you and our other brothers who would have to deal with us.
Luna held back her words and gave a bitter smile.
Just as Chiron had felt sorry for Jin, she felt the same. She believed that it should have been either Father or her who killed the evil deity.
"But recently Father suddenly overcame the demonic nature. He said it was an awakening that even you couldn't understand."
"An achievement that even Father can't understand the cause of...?"
"Don't you get it?"
"Yes, sister."
If one is a martial artist, anyone can know the reason when they gain enlightenment.
Naturally, Chiron was the man who had explored 'Mubu' (non-martial) in this world the most deeply. Jin couldn't imagine that such a father would not understand his own achievement.
A growth without a known reason usually caused side effects.
'But I can't imagine Father collapsing due to such side effects.'
Luna smiled.

"I think I know what you're thinking. The other knights and I thought the same. The conclusion we came to was that the demonic nature tried to corrupt Father in the end but failed and was extinguished. In other words, it lost in a fight with Father."
"Um."
"Father probably thinks the same? Anyway, the important thing is, Father has changed."
That part was definitely surprising.
The Supreme of Sword Clan, who was always so cold and calm, often made jokes and laughed at trivial things after overcoming his demonic nature.

"Upon entering the Black Sea and defeating Kiarl, the first monster we encountered, and while continuing to go deeper, Father was in a state of almost losing his humanity. But recently when defeating the beast, he was almost... um, how should I put it. Ah, like our great-grandfather?"
Luna naturally compared Chiron with Ballas, whom she had met and talked with earlier. In fact, when Chiron defeated the beast, he had laughed it off boisterously.
"But for some reason, I'm still worried."
"I'm not completely free of such feelings either. However, if Father encounters another problem, it's not our part to deal with. It would be a burden too heavy for us to dare share."
Jin nodded his head.
As it had always been, there was no choice but to trust Father and wait. For the day when he finally achieves his mission and returns to the family.

-Please take this opportunity to find out what mission Father and the former Black Knights were carrying out there, and why Father's Runcandel was so obsessed with the Black Sea. The purpose being for training, is certainly only half the truth.
Luna thought about what Jin had said before she left for the Black Sea.
"You've probably guessed while dealing with Gliek and going through various things, but the reason why Father is obsessed with the Black Sea is exactly because of them."

"Yes, when the evil deity occupied the family, such a knight came out. Father had already fought and fallen against the King of the Black Sea, and it was stated that after the family stabilized, they would conquer the Black Sea."
"The evil deity must have known the reason why Father had no choice but to go fight the kings of the Black Sea."
According to Luna,
The reason Chiron was defeating the kings of the Black Sea was because only he could accomplish that task.

"Father had met the kings of the Black Sea in his youth. They needed Father's power to reunite their divided selves into one. They needed the power of the star formation, especially a being who could defeat the will of the gods that divided the origin stone."
"Now that a new star formation mage named Elona Zipfel has appeared, I suppose the kings of the Black Sea might make similar requests to her."

"Father also sensed the existence of Elona Zipfel. He also knew that an unidentified force was trying to invade the ground. Elona is a star formation mage and Zito is a transcendent being. But Father said that even they couldn't unite the kings of the Black Sea. Because only you can, the kings of the Black Sea are obsessed with Father."
So, it was not only Chiron who was obsessed with the Black Sea.
Rather, the kings of the Black Sea were more obsessed with Chiron. They constantly posed invisible threats to Chiron, and Chiron did not want this to spread to the whole family.
Essentially, unless all the kings of the Black Sea were defeated, he and Runcandel could never be safe.
Even when all five kings of the Black Sea were intact, and now only Nirgand and Morganil remain.
The kings of the Black Sea were far more dangerous beings than Zipfel, the greatest enemy of the family.
"...... I can't help but think that perhaps Father was looking for a way to annihilate them."
"That was the case, until he overcame the demonic nature and the situation changed."
I felt the urge to go see Father in person right now.

However, the reason why Luna and the returnees were able to escape from the deepest part of the Black Sea so quickly was due to Chiron's energy being dispersed throughout the Black Sea. That energy had formed a path stretching from the deepest part of the Black Sea to the surface.

Naturally, that path was now closed, and Chiron and the remaining expedition members had moved deeper into the Black Sea. Even for Chiron, the act of forcibly creating a path like that couldn't be done at will multiple times.
"To disperse his energy throughout the Black Sea and temporarily create a path... I can't even imagine what realm our father is touching right now."
"I guess he's become not a demi-god, but a god. I wonder how many entities among the gods could do such a thing."
The fact that Chiron had entered an 'unexplained' awakening was still a sticking point, but thinking that he had been incarnated somehow gave a sense of relief.
"Nirgand and Morganil. Did he not mention how much time would be needed to subjugate the remaining two kings of the Black Sea, even approximately?"
"No, he didn't say anything about that. He said he would definitely take care of everything and return, so we have to wait while doing our own work. And maybe... on the day when father returns."
You'll inherit Barisada.
Luna finished the sentence in that way. You'll receive Barisada and finally become the true master of the Sword Clan, she said.
Jin felt odd, even though it was a story he knew.
"Won't you suddenly steal it then?"
"Oh... what will you do if I do that?"
"I'll give it to you."
"That's bland. Really?"
"Of course not. No matter if you're my sister, that's a bit much."
While the siblings were chuckling, the sound of someone running in the corridor was heard.
"Sister Luna!"
"First flagbearer... No, sister, sister!"
"We can call you sister too, right!?"
It was the siblings Mary and Tona.
During their time in the family, Luna did not interact with the siblings except for Jin.
Back then, most of the siblings had minor or major complaints about Luna due to the conflicts arising from her renouncing the throne and Joshua's rise to power.
Luna also never actively tried to make the siblings understand her intentions.
So, the relationship between Luna and the siblings was mostly cool, but it wasn't now. Luna, as well as the siblings who came to see her, were more warmly welcoming each other than ever before.
It was not just because a knight who was near the peak of the era had joined them, but because the long-missed 'sibling' had returned.

Over time, each of them faced trials in their respective positions and came to understand the past events. The turbulent family finally found a center with Jin at the forefront, and the siblings grew up. They overcame various trials in their respective places, as individuals.
"So, what will you call me? First Flagbearer? Lady Luna? Daytona, Haytona. Don't be self-conscious and be comfortable."
"Oh, thank you, sister!"
"In fact, we've always wanted to be close to you! It was our shortcoming that we couldn't."
"There's no need to thank. It wasn't just you who were lacking, I had a lot of problems too, so don't worry about it."
"Sister, will you spar with me later tonight?"
"Wow... Mary, you're really extraordinary."
"Now you'll have to take on some of the responsibilities that Deifus brother used to hold in my regard. I couldn't rely on the younger ones, could I? So, I've been waiting for you to return."
"... Alright, I can't replace him entirely, but I'll try my best. If not for anything else, then for that guy who fell with a heavy burden."
It was truly a long-awaited reunion for the siblings. Jin quietly smiled as he watched the suddenly lively atmosphere.
It was the first time he had seen the siblings all laughing and chatting together, in his past life and in this one.
"Sister, you're not going to talk separately to the youngest like in the old days, right? You'll have to repeat the conversation you had with the youngest to us."
"I will."
"Sister, when you spar later, please beat Mary up good. On behalf of me, who always gets beaten."
"Heh."
"Whoa, you startled me!"
Daytona looked surprised, turning to the side.
Yona was there out of the blue. Jin and Luna had already seen her sneak in through the entrance and were smiling at her.
"Heh, sister. Can I... can I talk to you?"
"I've been... very harsh on you all. Come closer, Yona."

As Luna comforted her shoulder, Yona giggled and suddenly recited the list of people she had killed while Luna was absent. It was to let her know that she hadn't killed those who Luna had said not to.
"And then the royal meatheads..."
"Enough, enough. Yona, I should have taken care of you more, but I only scared you. You did well, those guys should be killed."
For a moment, such conversations went on among the siblings. Sharing affection with the family they hadn't seen for a long time.
Soon after, Jin looked around at his siblings and brought up the name of the remaining person.
"Now that everyone is here, let's go meet sister Luntia."
